ranking: Original shortlist cells first in frozen order, then neighbour ring, original anchor rank and cell ID; source timing/uncertainty ranking within each cell
scope: Whole cells and reserved envelopes must independently meet existing training role and protected separation checks. Do not require prior reception in a neighbouring cell; interpolated supports can cross boundaries.
limits: Two 0.1-degree grid rings are a bounded geographic discovery choice, not a fixed distance or exhaustive NL search.
Pass context is acquisition start/end plus 15 minutes each side; native target-time source checks remain stricter and unchanged.
Heartbeat coverage is a connected-state diagnostic. It cannot measure unreceived vessels, upstream loss or complete AIS reception.
Legacy subscribed events mean a local send, not a server acknowledgement. Missing compression/confirmation telemetry remains unknown.
Receipt minus observation times use provider/client clocks; negative or missing times are disclosed and do not measure network latency alone.
No source, motion, shore, split, exposure or identity requirement is relaxed to fill a batch. No pixels or scores are used for reservation.
Metadata reservations require native input, uncertainty, complete annotation, object association and permitted-use checks before provisional training admission.
No independent reviewer, accuracy truth, model improvement, operational threshold or promotion is supplied.
